egress.terms: Self-hosted deployment: traffic is governed by host network terms.

record.chaining: composes only with a server that a user pays for, so it is self-hosted software, not a free service.
record.reliability_note: no credible free public frps was found; every 'free frp server' lead was a VPS advertisement

evidence.proved: frps and frpc 0.71.1 on one host with a tcp proxy: GET /blob4m.bin returned 200 with 4,194,304 bytes, sha256 46386cf4dbccceb80f80148d46d37f1a30d72912089cfbe4b3e51d9d55a79747 matching the source, 0.093 s, 42.91 MiB/s against 38.73 MiB/s direct

record.notes: Open-source reverse proxy software for publishing local services behind NAT or firewalls. Self-hosted tool requiring deployment on external server infrastructure.

extras.transit_note: no hosted free tier exists; the 4 MiB probe ran against a local frps and the bytes transited this host
extras.hosting_requirement: a rented or free compute service with a public address; no local machine is assumed

record.confidence_note: frps and frpc 0.71.1 ran on this host: a 4,194,304-byte object read back through the TCP proxy byte-identically, sha256 46386cf4dbccceb80f80148d46d37f1a30d72912089cfbe4b3e51d9d55a79747, 42.91 MiB/s against a 38.73 MiB/s direct baseline. No hosted free tier exists, so this measures the software and not a service
record.binding_note: the software imposes no limit, so what runs out first is the monthly egress allowance of the host it runs on, and that host is a separate provider with its own bill

history.title: Self-hosted ingress is not a free service
